basic_information.title: Intelligent Mental Health Companion and Mood Analytics Tracker
basic_information.summary: A mobile-first web application that acts as a conversational companion, tracking users' moods through natural language processing and providing personalized coping strategies.

abstract: Mental well-being is increasingly recognized as a critical component of overall health, yet access to psychological support remains limited for many. This project developed an 'Intelligent Mental Health Companion,' a conversational agent designed to interact with users, track their emotional states, and offer evidence-based coping mechanisms. Utilizing Natural Language Processing (NLP) techniques, particularly sentiment analysis and emotion classification, the system processes daily journal entries and chat interactions to quantify the user's mood over time. The application provides visual analytics of mood trends, helping users identify emotional triggers. While not a replacement for professional therapy, the companion serves as an accessible tool for self-reflection and emotional regulation.
problem_statement: Many individuals struggle with daily stress and mild anxiety but lack accessible tools for tracking their emotional well-being and practicing self-care techniques between professional therapy sessions or on their own.

primary: Develop a conversational AI interface capable of empathetic interactions.
Implement NLP models to extract sentiment and specific emotions from user text.
Create a dashboard visualizing mood trends over days, weeks, and months.
secondary: Curate a database of mindfulness exercises and coping strategies to recommend based on detected moods.
Ensure high standards of data privacy and anonymity for user entries.

included: Emotion classification (e.g., joy, sadness, anger, anxiety).
Automated recommendation of breathing exercises and articles.
excluded: Clinical diagnosis of mental health disorders.
target_users: General public seeking mental wellness tools
scope.deployment_context: Progressive Web Application (PWA) accessible on mobile and desktop devices.

features.name: Conversational Journaling
features.description: Users interact with a chatbot to log their daily experiences and feelings.

features.name: Emotion Analytics Dashboard
features.description: Displays charts and graphs representing the user's emotional journey over time.

features.name: Personalized Coping Strategies
features.description: Suggests specific exercises (e.g., 4-7-8 breathing) when high stress or anxiety is detected.

modules.name: NLP Processing Module
modules.purpose: Analyzes text input to determine sentiment and emotion categories.
responsibilities: Output confidence scores for various emotions.

modules.name: Recommendation Engine
modules.purpose: Maps detected emotional states to appropriate interventions.
responsibilities: Query the intervention database for matching strategies.

programming_languages.name: Python
programming_languages.purpose: NLP model serving and API development.

frameworks.name: Flask
frameworks.purpose: Lightweight backend API for handling text analysis requests.

frameworks.name: Vue.js
frameworks.purpose: Reactive frontend framework for the chat interface.

frameworks.name: Hugging Face Transformers
frameworks.purpose: Library for utilizing pre-trained NLP models.

database.name: SQLite
database.purpose: Local database for development and storing anonymized journal entries.

tools.name: Chart.js
tools.purpose: Render interactive mood graphs on the frontend.

ai_usage.description: Utilizes AI for both understanding user emotions (classification) and generating empathetic responses (generation).
ai_usage.training_data: Pre-trained models fine-tuned on public emotion datasets (e.g., GoEmotions).

algorithms.name: Transformer Attention Mechanism
algorithms.purpose: Underlies the NLP models used for understanding text context.

reasons: Integration of multiple AI models via APIs.
Designing a safe and empathetic conversational flow.

phase_breakdown.phase: Frontend chat interface and dashboard development
User testing and prompt engineering refinement

expected_outcomes: A functional PWA capable of conversational journaling and emotion tracking.
A structured database of coping strategies mapped to emotional states.
A project report evaluating the accuracy of the emotion classification against human labeling.
limitations: The AI lacks true clinical understanding and may misinterpret complex or sarcastic inputs.
Conversational models can sometimes generate generic or repetitive responses.
User engagement may drop if the companion does not provide continuous perceived value.
future_scope: Integrate voice recognition for spoken journal entries.
Develop a feature to export mood reports for sharing with real human therapists.
Improve personalized recommendations using reinforcement learning based on user feedback.
